title: Security Forces Kill 15 Militants in Multi-District Balochistan Operations
detail: Pakistani security forces killed 15 militants belonging to Fitna al-Khawarij (the state's term for TTP-linked networks it describes as India-backed) during a series of intelligence-based operations conducted under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna 3 across eight Balochistan districts: Mastung, Bolan, Washuk, Awaran, Sibi, Khuzdar, Harnai, and Nushki. A large quantity of weapons and ammunition was recovered from the militants killed. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi praised security forces for the operations.
